parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.ORBIT_CHEAP_MODEL || 'openai/gpt-4o-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a reply classifier for Orbit (AI receptionist agency). Classify the inbound prospect reply into EXACTLY ONE of these 13 categories:

1. positive — enthusiastic, wants to move forward
2. interested — shows interest but not fully committed
3. question — asking about product, pricing, or details
4. pricing — specifically asking about cost or pricing
5. not_now — interested but wants to revisit later
6. referral — refers to someone else or asks to loop someone in
7. unsubscribe — wants to be removed from future contact
8. negative — not interested, rejects the offer
9. wrong_person — reached wrong contact or role
10. out_of_office — auto-reply or vacation responder
11. automatic_reply — system-generated, not a real person
12. meeting_request — wants to schedule a call or meeting
13. unknown — cannot determine category

Return ONLY valid JSON: {"category": "...", "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "suggested_response": "..."}. Confidence must reflect how certain you are. For unsubscribe, always set confidence >= 0.9.' }, { role: 'user', content: String($json.text || JSON.parse($json.payload||'{}').text || '') }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: JSON.parse($('Reply events').item.json.payload).lead_id, intent_class: $json.llm.intent_class, confidence: $json.llm.confidence, suggested_response: $json.llm.suggested_response }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: JSON.parse($('Reply events').item.json.payload).lead_id, intent_class: $json.llm.intent_class, confidence: $json.llm.confidence, suggested_response: $json.llm.suggested_response }) }}

meta.description: n8n owns LLM classification (spec 10.3) with 13-category taxonomy and confidence scoring. Escalation rules: positive/interested/meeting_request/not_now/referral/wrong_person replies are flagged for human review. The API persists replies durably + fires the kill switch BEFORE this workflow runs; if n8n is down the reply is never lost — it just stays HUMAN_REQUIRED.
